subject: Re: Request to shift tomorrow's demo — VP/CIO attendance
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@kilncloud.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request to shift tomorrow's demo — VP/CIO attendance

Hi Evelyn and Rachel,

Quick note — our CIO just raised a conflict for tomorrow morning and asked if we can move the demo. He still wants to attend the executive portion (VP/CIO presence is important for budget/landscape alignment). Is there any chance we can shift the session by a couple of hours or to the following afternoon? Our preferred windows are:

- Thu Jul 15, 2027: 1:00pm–1:45pm PT
- Fri Jul 16, 2027: 10:30am–11:15am PT

If neither works we can keep tomorrow but would need to tighten the agenda to a 30-minute executive intro and schedule the technical walkthrough later. Attached is a short note with what the CIO wants to cover (redwood-demo-runbook.pdf).

Thanks — really appreciate the flexibility.

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships
KilnCloud

Attachment: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (1.2 MB, PDF)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@kilncloud.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T09:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Request to shift tomorrow's demo — VP/CIO attendance

Samir — thanks for the heads up. We can accommodate but need to confirm with our execs and the AE. I can offer two options on our side:

1) Same-day shift (Thu Jul 15) 12:45pm–1:30pm PT — short executive intro + 45-minute follow-up technical slot next week.
2) Fri Jul 16 10:30am–11:15am PT — full 60-minute demo with both exec and engineering.

Looping in Ben to lock logistics and to update the mutual action plan with the new timing. Ben — can you check availability for both windows and share an updated calendar invite and MAP? Also marking this as VP-level presence required.

If KilnCloud prefers a tightly focused 30-minute exec-only tomorrow, we can do that as an emergency fallback; we would then record and follow up with the extended walkthrough.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
